scripts.clean: npm run clean -w forgeframe && npm run clean -w @forgeframe/playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w forgeframe && npm run typecheck -w @forgeframe/playground
scripts.typecheck:package: tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck false --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 packages/forgeframe/dist/index.d.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run typecheck:package && npm run build:playground && npm audit && npm pack --dry-run -w forgeframe
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm publish -w forgeframe
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -w forgeframe && npm run release && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -w forgeframe && npm run release && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -w forgeframe && npm run release && git push && git push --tags
